title: Why I default to static hosting
excerpt: For a solo builder, the best server is often the one you don't have to run, patch, or pay for while it sits idle.

title: Ship the narrow version first
excerpt: A smaller thing that's finished beats a bigger thing that's almost there — most of what I build starts by cutting scope, not adding it.

title: Serving markdown from a static GitHub Pages site
excerpt: GitHub Pages has no server to run, so "serving markdown" means shipping the .md files as static assets and rendering them in the browser.
